prompt:
ok I want to kick off a codex session overnight on gpt-6 astra to finish the invoice pdf export. here's the prompt I used last month for the csv export (old-prompt.md), can you update it for this?

context: the pdf renderer is in services/billing/pdf/. it's half done, line items render but the totals + tax rows don't, and multi-page invoices get cut off after page 1. the design is docs/invoice-pdf.md. golden files are tests/golden/invoices/*.pdf and `make test-pdf` compares against them (pixel diff). don't let it touch services/billing/ledger, Dana's team is mid-migration there. it can't hit the real tax API (costs money per call), there's a stub, TAX_API_STUB=1. last time the agent stopped after about an hour and asked me if it should continue, and I was asleep.

write the new one to goal.md

Input files: old-prompt.md
assertions: goal.md defines completion by `make test-pdf` passing (or the golden files in tests/golden/invoices matching)
goal.md says not to change services/billing/ledger
goal.md says to use the tax stub (TAX_API_STUB=1) and not call the real tax API
goal.md tells the agent to keep working through ordinary problems without stopping to ask whether to continue, and says what to do if it is truly blocked
goal.md contains none of these words in capitals: CRITICAL, IMPORTANT, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS
goal.md does not prescribe a step-by-step method or a reading order for the agent (a statement of the two known defects and of what done means is fine)
goal.md does not tell the agent to think step by step, think hard, be thorough or double-check
goal.md does not contain a blanket rule to ask before modifying or changing anything
goal.md states both known defects: totals and tax rows don't render, and multi-page invoices are cut off after page 1
